name: Quiet month
description: Nothing happened. The street was open, the weather was ordinary, no competitor filed anything. Revenue wobbles within normal variance.
expectation: The engine should decline to explain the wobble. No driver should take a meaningful share, unexplained should be nearly all of a small residual, and confidence should be LOW - because there is no signal, not because the model is broken. This scenario exists to prove the engine says 'I don't know' when it doesn't.
